lines: TG01: Target implementation with Web SDK [one-time]
TG02: Users, workspaces and audiences setup [one-time]
TG03: Testing roadmap and first activities [one-time]
TG05: Monthly test design, build and analysis [monthly]
sections: We would deliver this with Target.
We will enable Target in the datastream, add flicker handling, render Visual and Form-based Experience Composer activities, pass profile and entity data, and validate the setup.
We will add users and roles, create workspaces and properties where you have Target Premium, and set up the reporting, environment and starting audience settings.
We will run an ideation and prioritization workshop, write activity plans with hypotheses and success metrics, then build, QA and launch the first A/B and Experience Targeting activities.
Each month we will design, build, QA and launch the next activities on the roadmap, analyze results by audience, and share readouts and next steps with stakeholders.
draft.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with Target.

What we would do
- We will enable Target in the datastream, add flicker handling, render Visual and Form-based Experience Composer activities, pass profile and entity data, and validate the setup.
- We will add users and roles, create workspaces and properties where you have Target Premium, and set up the reporting, environment and starting audience settings.
- We will run an ideation and prioritization workshop, write activity plans with hypotheses and success metrics, then build, QA and launch the first A/B and Experience Targeting activities.

After launch
- Each month we will design, build, QA and launch the next activities on the roadmap, analyze results by audience, and share readouts and next steps with stakeholders.

Sources
- Set up Adobe Target with Platform Web SDK: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/platform-learn/implement-web-sdk/applications-setup/setup-target
- Configure enterprise permissions: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/target/using/administer/manage-users/enterprise/properties-overview
- Chapter 3: Develop your testing and personalization ideas: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/target/using/introduction/welcome/target-welcome-kit-3
